scenarios.name: Switch between states with different feature suppression

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open in the MCAD Software
the user creates model states Capture State and Copy State
the user sets the extrusion to Suppress in Primary and Capture State and Compute in Copy State through the model-state table
The MCAD Software has a part with Primary and Copy State model states
the extrusion is suppressed in Primary and computed in Copy State
Copy State is active and its solid body is visible
the user activates the Primary model state
the Primary model state is marked active
the solid body is absent from the viewport
the extrusion row is dimmed and struck through
the solid body is visible in the viewport
the extrusion row is no longer struck through
